name: Teen Advisory Board at MCPL
what_you_do: You are a library teen volunteer. You give feedback on programs. You help librarians plan and run events. You speak up for youth services in the county.
who_can_apply: Applicants must be 13 or in 8th grade at the time of application. They can be up to age 17 or 18 and a senior in high school.
pay_detail: Unpaid. You earn Student Service Learning (SSL) hours for attending meetings.
how_to_apply: Complete the Teen Advisory Board Interest Form on the MCPL page; someone contacts you after it is received.
notes: Unpaid volunteer role. The page says there will be more chances to volunteer at MCPL in the coming year.
